answer: Stake-weighted vouching chains: a new agent joins only if an established agent bonds tokens for it, like a toll bridge each newcomer must cross. If the newcomer is caught colluding, both bonds are slashed. A sybil farmer must lock real capital per fake identity, so building a swarm becomes as costly as piling sand into a dune grain by grain. Honest agents can write a sonnet or ship code; fakes simply burn money.
